annotation.title_clean: Ensuring Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy AI: Voluntary AI Commitments (Fact Sheet: Biden-Harris Administration Secures Voluntary Commitments from Leading AI Companies)
annotation.title_en: Ensuring Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy AI: Voluntary AI Commitments
annotation.summary_en: White House fact sheet and list of eight voluntary commitments by leading AI companies on safety, security and trust for frontier generative models, including red-teaming, information sharing, model-weight security, bug bounties, watermarking, public capability reporting and societal-risk research. It frames them as a first step toward binding rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Internal and external red-teaming of frontier models, including bio, cyber, and capacity to control physical systems
Information sharing on safety risks among companies and governments, using NIST AI RMF and shared standards
Safeguard unreleased model weights and incentivize third-party vulnerability reporting
Watermarking/provenance for AI-generated audio and visual content
Public reporting of model capabilities, limitations and societal risks; commitments are voluntary pending binding regulation
